1.17.0.title: Listen in Hindi or English
1.17.0.detail: Choose Hindi on an English series page, or English on a Hindi one. A system voice reads the translated transcript, so you don't need the recording. The wording may not be perfect.

1.17.0.title: At Osho's pace
1.17.0.detail: The voice pauses the way Osho does, so each paragraph takes about as long as in his talk.

1.17.0.title: Keeps going when you lock your phone
1.17.0.detail: Follow the progress on the Lock Screen, and start listening to the finished part while the rest is prepared.

1.17.0.title: The same moment in both
1.17.0.detail: Switch between the translation and Osho's recording without losing your place. Bookmarks save the moment in the recording.
